label: post-restart

original.description: Application-container limits; shared databases, host NATS, Wasm sidecar and control plane are outside this budget.

tuned.description: Allocation sensitivity: unchanged total CPU/RAM; Java order 1200m, inventory 600m, notification 150m, product 50m.

measurement_protocol.selection: Use tuned Java if its confirmed rate is at least original; otherwise retain original. Repeats retest its confirmed bracket.
measurement_protocol.stability: 1800 seconds at the minimum passing confirmation rate across all three repeats; no stability run if any repeat has no passing confirmation.
measurement_protocol.caveats: One shared local VM; per-application budgets exclude databases, messaging, Wasm sidecar and monitoring. Warmup now 100/s, so do not pool earlier 25/s-warmup results.

interruption_policy: Repeat only the incomplete child; retain its partial raw report separately. Completed failed performance gates remain part of the matrix.
stability: Use the original minimum passing-confirmation rate if all three confirmations pass; otherwise the predeclared common passing short-step fallback capped at400/s. If neither qualifies a Wasm rate, run one separately labelled diagnostic30-minute350/s trial at the lowest originally scheduled Wasm rate. Do not interpret that diagnostic as qualified capacity. No lower-rate retry.
comparability: Different selected long-run rates must not be used for matched-load CPU efficiency ratios. Shared infrastructure is outside application budgets.
